PROJECT OVERVIEW: CONFIGURATOR & E-COMMERCE ECOSYSTEM

Building a custom PC is a high-cognitive-load task involving complex compatibility checks and budget tracking. I was commissioned to design an end-to-end solution that simplifies this journey, from initial part selection to final checkout via Amazon integration.

As the lead Designer and Product Strategist, I managed the full lifecycle: from identifying market gaps and defining technical requirements to brand identity and high-fidelity UI delivery.

STRATEGIC RESEARCH & DISCOVERY

To inform the product's foundation, I conducted a competitive audit of existing PC builder applications. I identified a significant friction point: most tools were either visually overwhelming for novices or lacked a direct bridge to purchasing.

  • Gap Analysis: Evaluated strengths and weaknesses in current tools to ensure our solution offered a superior UX.
  • Trend & Feasibility Study: Researched 2019 UI trends and technical guidelines to ensure the application was both modern and scalable.
  • Target Audience Mapping: Segmented users to tailor the interface for both "Hardcore Gamers" (high spec focus) and "General Creators" (budget focus).

PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS & SYSTEM LOGIC

By synthesising client discussions with research data, I defined a "Must-Have" feature set aimed at reducing user drop-off during the configuration process:

  • Information Hierarchy: Users can sort components by technical specs and price.
  • Persistence & Customisation: Capability to name and manage multiple custom PC build lists simultaneously.
  • E-commerce Integration: A seamless "Add to Basket" bridge with Amazon to facilitate instant conversion.
  • Transparency: Real-time calculation of individual part costs and cumulative "Total Build" price to assist with budgeting.
  • Deep-Dive Navigation: Dedicated "Part Information" views for users requiring detailed technical validation.

LOGO DESIGN & VISUAL PSYCHOLOGY

Before tackling the UI, I developed the brand identity. I utilised 2019’s "Almost-Flat" icon trend, incorporating subtle shadows to add depth while maintaining efficiency. The circular motif was chosen to represent the "System Lifecycle," symbolising durability and the continuous nature of tech.

Strategic Colour Rationale:

  • White: Communicates efficiency and minimalist simplicity.
  • Green: Signals security and the "fresh start" of a new build.
  • Blue: Evokes calm and corporate reliability, an industry standard for tech.
  • Black: Projects professionalism and high-performance power.

I ultimately selected a Dark Blue primary tone to promote precision and ensure high contrast against white design elements.

ARCHITECTURE & PLANNING

I mapped the application's visual system to the brand identity while investigating the technical feasibility of the Amazon API.

  • Wireframing: Produced rapid sketches and structural wireframes to investigate the user journey and interaction patterns.
  • Technical Spiking: Researched the Amazon integration process to ensure the design supported a functional checkout flow.

UI ITERATION: THE DESIGN PIVOT

Based on initial client feedback and the dark-theme trends of 2019, I first produced a high-fidelity "Dark Mode" concept.

The Iteration: Following a collaborative review with the client, we determined that the dark aesthetic, while trendy, did not provide the level of clarity needed for a data-heavy parts list. I pivoted to a Light UI, opting for a brighter, clean aesthetic that improved readability and made the configuration process feel more accessible and trustworthy.

FINAL PRODUCT & IMPACT

The final solution is a high-utility configurator that balances complex technical requirements with a streamlined UI.

Key Successes:

  • End-to-End Ownership: Demonstrated the ability to navigate the full product lifecycle from stakeholder interviews to technical developer handoff.
  • Conversion-Driven UX: Successfully integrated e-commerce functionality (Amazon) to turn a "planning tool" into a "buying tool."
  • User-Centric Flexibility: Balanced the needs for sorting, budgeting, and technical research into a cohesive, responsive experience.

childMarkdownRemark.excerpt: Design a PC Builder Phone App

childMarkdownRemark.html: As a UX Designer, I took on the challenge of designing a comprehensive PC Builder Application. This project aimed to assist PC builders, gamers, and business professionals in designing and budgeting custom PC builds. My role focused on user research, requirement gathering, and UX/UI design to deliver a product that meets the specific needs of its target audience.
